evidence.reason: The splice at line 333 is an explicitly documented harness limitation (lines 316-320): the gh seam is not recorded byte-exactly, so the test intentionally replaces only the titles while still validating the gh call log at line 347 and all other fields through the fixture bytes. The finding asks to enlarge the oracle to compare implementation-produced titles using recorded gh responses, but the supplied evidence does not establish that such responses exist or that the current contract requires this stronger test. This is a test-hardening proposal, not an existing correctness defect.
